description: Reviewed as the "Best" and "Favorite" file manager for Windows 8 Modern UI!   Simple, responsive, and stable, File Brick combines local drive and cloud storage to help you explore your files more easily while providing full functions of a file manager. More than that, File Brick also serves the role to link your social network including Facebook and Twitter, and media channels such as Youtube, Picasa and Flickr.
